title: publish
description: Plugin to host: the plugin's catalog, or the rows of the one source it names. One malformed or over-quota row rejects the whole publish, and the host keeps the previous catalog.

rows.$comment: At most 4194304 bytes as written in the frame, summed over the plugin's sources after a per-source merge.

source.description: A manifest sources[].name that every row carries: the publish replaces that source's rows alone.
